name: True Glass
author: Eddie175
description: Real glass for Omarchy. The bar, menus, notifications and windows bend the light at their edges like a lens, and menus pour out of the bar like liquid. Auto frost, Dark and Light glass, Thin or Thick, round corners, six window light styles, clear terminals and a glass lock screen. Works with every theme, light on resources, and turning it off puts everything back.

barWidget.description: Turn True Glass on and set how the glass looks
